source_identity: R2 M6 WESTERN_GENERIC policy pack v1 (spec section 5.1-5.2)

rules.description: Exact Canon/branch/map lineage must hold; no runtime latest substitution.
Every source/target reference in the map and screenplay closes over real evidence.
Every map entry uses one of the nine frozen adaptation operations.
Scene and shot identity is exact and ordered; no silent reorder or duplicate.
KnowledgeState and secret constraints from Canon are never disclosed early or leaked.
State, prop, and location continuity holds across every adapted scene.
Content and profile digests bind exactly; no unverified reference is trusted.
Production candidate and master selection is exact-current, never stale.
Every scene declares a well-formed INT./EXT. heading with location and time-of-day.
Action description and dialogue are structurally separable per scene.
Action description names only what a camera could see or a microphone could hear.
Every scene's source_mapping_refs resolves against the map's own entries.
Delivery constraints explicitly selected by this versioned pack are met.

Problem, goal/action, opposition, stakes, cause/effect, escalation, revelation, reversal, and resolution are evidence-backed observations, never a universal numeric score or fixed beat timestamp, and never auto-reject a valid slow-burn, tragic, or unresolved excerpt.
